summary: ADR-0057 accepted 2026-08-05; knowledge publication restricted to maintain-knowledge-base via separately confirmed append-only request; request binds caller, trigger, one pinned-main target plan, current main commit, nonautomatic flag, timestamp, knowledge-publication authority, and hash-verified stale-maintenance route; publish_knowledge_catalog.py --publish fails closed without bindings; Acceptance stale handling is typed, hash-bound, append-only, and non-authorizing; VDD/Acceptance reject outputs outside exact target directory; global plan indexing includes stable semantic sources only, excluding authority manifests and knowledge contexts to prevent recursive freshness loops; standalone catalog builder read-only, publication gate alone activates formal layers and requires validated capability; discovery supports versioned top-level files with highest numeric version plus requirements-ledger/requirements names; historical reads and existing generations remain compatible, new publications store summary/hash; extends ADR-0044, ADR-0048, ADR-0050; no supersession
